title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression gating and CI hook for eval metrics
author: Asha Patel
description: Add automated prompt-set regression gating to the evaluation harness and surface metric-based failures in the CI pipeline. Motivation: we observed accidental prompt regressions during model rollouts that were only caught post-deploy; this PR introduces threshold-driven checks, a lightweight metrics diff format for CI, and a gating job that fails builds when quality drops exceed configured tolerances. Changes include: 1) eval-harness runner support for baseline artifacts and per-prompt thresholds; 2) an eval-metrics checker that emits a compact JSON summary and exit codes based on regression severity; 3) CI pipeline integration (ci/pipeline.yml) to run full eval on release branches and a fast-check on PRs; 4) example prompt-set and threshold configs; 5) docs and test coverage. This is intended to be conservative by default (fail only on significant regressions) and configurable via repo-level eval-config.yaml. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan.
